[[File:Reward casket (hard) detail.png|left|130px]]
A '''[[reward casket]] (hard)''' is received after completing the final clue of a [[Clue scroll (hard)|hard clue scroll]] trail, and contains the final reward for the trail. Opening the reward casket is required for treasure trail completion to be tracked on the [[HiScores]] and [[collection log]].

The player can possess unlimited amounts of reward caskets up to the [[Stackable_items#Limit_of_a_stack|stack limit]]. Players are eligible to receive more clue scrolls regardless of how many reward caskets are in the player's possession.

==Rewards==
Hard clues generate a minimum of 4 rewards and a maximum of 6, granting an average of 5 rewards per casket. The rewards consist of generic items, shared treasure trail items, and items that are unique for hard clues. Additionally, players have a 1/15 chance of receiving a [[master clue scroll]] upon opening a hard casket. On average, it will take 5484 reward caskets to obtain all the (non-mega-rare) unique drops specific to hard clues (not including drops shared by other clue tiers).

All droprates are confirmed by [[Mod Tide]].{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Tide|url=https://twitter.com/JagexTide/status/1131933683714330624|date=24 May 2019|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/106558|archivedate=24 May 2019|quote=I know its been a while since the clue expansion but here is the information on clue scroll drop rates and loot chances! If anything changes I will keep you posted.|name=Clue rates tweet}}{{CiteGeneral|url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/16pVNHdZyynmxIbM9mynRDYT0LQsWxq-vbDs4_7DpnGM/edit?usp=sharing|title=Clue scrolls 2019|author=|time=24 May 2019}} The listed rarities are per roll.

The average loot roll is worth {{Coins|{{HardClueValue}}}} and average hard clues are worth {{Coins|5 * {{HardClueValue}}}}, without considering the value from potential master clues. The 1/15 chance of receiving a master clue scroll adds another {{Coins|1/15 * (6 * {{MasterClueValue}} + 1/15 * {{MasterMimicValue}})}}, for a total expected value per clue of {{Coins|5 * {{HardClueValue}} + 1/15 * (6 * {{MasterClueValue}} + 1/15 * {{MasterMimicValue}})}}.

===Hard clue uniques===

* The droprate for any hard clue unique (excluding those in the Mega-Rare Table) is 1/12.5 per reward roll. With an average of 5 rolls, the probability to receive a clue scroll unique item from a hard casket is 5x 1/12.5, which becomes 1/2.93 or 34.1%.

==Changes==
{{Subject changes header}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 15 August 2019
|update = Small Game Updates and Betas
|poll = Old School Content Poll 68: Small Game Improvements
|change = The locks on the reward casket have been changed to reflect the tier of Treasure Trail it comes from.
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 11 April 2019
|update = Treasure Trails Expansion and Easter 2019
|poll = Old School Content Poll 65: Treasure Trails Expansion
|change = All Treasure Trails caskets were changed to be stackable. To bolster each tier of clue with new cosmetic items, seventeen new items were added as hard clue scroll rewards.
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 6 July 2016
|update = Treasure Trail Expansion (2016)
|poll = Old School Content Poll 42: Clue Scrolls Expansion
|change = All of the lower tier clues are getting many new additions to the drop tables.
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 12 June 2014
|update = Treasure Trail Expansion
|poll = Old School feature poll 19
|change = There are over 180 new items available to be discovered by solving clue scrolls including third age weaponry, new outfits and a host of other items. There are new rewards and brand new clues for every level of treasure trail.
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 6 March 2014
|update = Teletabs, Clues and Poll 17
|poll = Old School feature poll 16
|change = Clue scrolls and caskets now state the levels in their names.
}}

==Trivia==

*With the [[Update:Treasure Trail Expansion|12 June 2014 update]] 41 new unique rewards were added to hard clue scrolls. With the [[Update:Treasure Trail Expansion (2016)|6 July 2016 update]] another 8 rewards were added to hard clue scroll uniques. With the [[Update:Barbarian Assault Ranged Rework|25 Jan 2018 update]], [[Dragon boots ornament kit]] was added.
*In 2016 Mod Mat K revealed in a [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=m-5hXaHEzIM&t=465s data stream] that on average 13,000 hard clue scrolls were completed every day.
